reasoning: The icon depicts a vertical path splitting upward into two arrows—one solid and one dashed—clearly conveying a fork, decision, alternative route, or A/B split. It fits tasks centered on making a choice between two options, planning a backup/detour, or branching a technical workflow, though it resembles generic git fork or road-split icons at small sizes.
